_comment: Expectation manifest for this skill's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern / in-flight item). MUST exit 0 or 1;
>=2 is harness rot (it failed to RUN). A red check that turns GREEN does NOT
fail the gate -- it prints a promote-me notice; move it to green when its fix lands.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate: an unlisted check is an unguarded check.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file -- otherwise a loop could flip a
regressing check to "red" and escape its own fence.

mutations.why: the non-ASCII test goes back to edge labels only, so an em-dash in a NODE label sails through and btoa() throws at render in the browser -- the exact regression this check was written for
the template loses its fullscreen entry point, so the chart cannot be opened full-screen and a large graph is unreadable in the panel-width column

_note: The only check here that asserts against the PAGE rather than label escaping.
validate.mjs is the skill's stated load-bearing gate but only ever read Mermaid labels, so a
page with no h1, no styles and no Mermaid script printed PASS. Observed while building a real
flowchart. Proven RED on that baseline.
Assertion 3 (the unfilled template must fail) has no mutation of its own: it trips BOTH the
placeholder and the marker finding, so neutering either one leaves the other and the assertion
still holds. It is guarded by the same reporting path as assertion 1, which mutation 3 breaks.

mutations.why: the structural pass is never invoked, so a page that is rubble below the graph passes on clean labels alone
the page contract fires on bare mermaid fragments too, which turns every sibling fixture in this suite red -- the over-broad fix that satisfies the invariant by breaking the suite
structural findings are still computed but never recorded -- the refactor that keeps every call site and silently drops the reporting, which no assertion on a sub-check would catch
mutations.find: const add = (msg, needle) => out.push({ line: at(needle), msg });
